title: GUVA Audit Event Envelope (v1)
description: CloudEvents-shaped wrapper every producer writes to the audit topic. The envelope shape is locked; service-defined payload sits in `data`.

specversion.description: CloudEvents spec version. Bump only when the envelope shape itself changes.

id.description: Producer-generated event UUID; used as the dedupe key on the audit chain.

source.description: Identifier of the producer (service name, client id, gateway name).

sourcekind.description: What kind of actor the source is. Enumerated so spelling drift is caught at publish time.

subject.description: Stable id of the thing acted on. Empty string allowed when not subject-scoped.

subjectkind.description: What kind of thing the subject is. Empty string allowed when not subject-scoped.

time.description: When the producer observed the event (ISO 8601, UTC).

correlationid.description: Request correlation id (X-Correlation-Id), if any. Empty string when not available.

result.description: Outcome of the action from the producer's point of view.

data.description: Service-defined detail. Keep it small (~1 KB) and stable; PII goes in the system of record, not here.
